name: Angel Egg: This Is Not My Body
summary: young and timid UTA lives on the planet ARION, full of angels. at a certain age they are supposed to grow feathery wings... but she ends up growing freaky meat tentacles. it seems to be some kind of parasite - so why does nobody else want to help? poor UTA has to figure out whats wrong with her before the parasite eats her alive ...
